notes.title: ✨Our latest demo will be featured in Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Hello, dear player!

During the Steam Next Fest this October, from October 14th to 21st, we are excited to bring you the latest demo from The Lilliput Workshop. You can enjoy playing to your heart's content this time!

If you like it, please add the game to your wishlist!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42536836/a4563960258f71fc5059673416ec8dd8dddc68a8.png

This demo has fixed previous bugs and improved the gaming experience. We've also added comprehensive English localization, significantly enhancing the overall quality of the game. 

We highly recommend you download and give it a try! There will be more surprises in store for you, including the latest news on our game's release, improvements, new platform updates, and more.

Your feedback and support are our greatest motivation. Thank you so much for your continued support. We are dedicated to bringing you the best content and look forward to moving forward together with you.

Cotton Game

notes.title: 🌟 《The Liliput Workshop》New Demo Live Now! Join Our Prize-Winning Event🌟
notes.content:
Hello Gamers!

Exciting news— 《The Liliput Workshop》will join the Wholesome Games Celebration from August 15th-21st! Celebrate games that bring joy and introspection.

What's in Store?

Try our new demo, featuring enhanced prologue and fresh chapter one content. We've listened to your feedback and can't wait for you to see the improvements!
Participants providing feedback will have a chance to win exclusive gifts.

Your Feedback Matters!

Play the demo and help us develop. Your insights are crucial!

Event Details

Event Period: August 15th, 1 PM PT - August 22nd, 1 PM PT
How to Participate: Play the demo and share anything related to Woolly Boy And The Circus on X or Discord and tag us!

X: @CottonStudio
Discord: Cotton Games

Prizes: We'll randomly select 6 lucky guys from X and Discord participants
Prizes Include: Steam Keys for Mr. Pumpkin 2: Kowloon Walled City

Other Cotton Games Recommendation

Don't miss out on other Cotton Games like Sunset Hills, gearing up for offically launching.
Before Fate, Reviver and Woolly Boy And The Circus are on the way!

Support and Follow

Subscribe《The Liliput Workshop》and add us to your wishlist for the latest updates and festival perks!

Thanks for your support! See you at the festival!

Cheers,

The Liliput Workshop Team
